prompt: Implement the Rename refactoring: replace a symbol everywhere without corrupting longer names that merely contain it. Complete IdentifierRenamer, then run the tests.
explanation: The whole exercise turns on one predicate: a textual hit is a real identifier only when neither neighbouring character could be part of the same name. Factoring that test into isWholeMatch lets both counting and rewriting share it, and it is exactly the check a naive source.replace(old, new) skips -- which is why Find-Replace mangles count1 while Rename does not. rename walks the source once with a StringBuilder, jumping oldName.length() characters on a match so the replacement text is never re-scanned.
hints: Character.isLetterOrDigit covers most of isIdentifierPart; add '_' and '$' yourself.
Write a private helper isWholeMatch(source, name, start) that checks the character before start and the character just past the name -- remember the start-of-string and end-of-string cases.
In rename, walk an index through the source: on a whole match append newName and skip oldName.length() characters, otherwise append one character and move on.
